newsitem.title: USA: APS sees FY 1998 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: APS sees FY 1998 EPS below estimates.

text.p: APS Holding Corp said Monday it believes it will fall short of the range of analysts' earnings per share estimates for fiscal 1998.
In March the company said it was comfortable with the lower end of analysts' estimates, which ranged from $0.75 to $1.40 per share.

In its revised outlook, APS said it is not seeing sustained improvement either in the operating performance of its Installers' Service Warehouse division or in the underlying business conditions of the automotive aftermarket.
The company's fiscal year began January 26.
